title: erp.costing.accounting_fact.v1
description: erp/costing's cost facts (a receipt valued, the cost of an issue, a purchase return, the adjustments when a cost layer's price source is replaced) on the stream erp.costing, in erp/finance's shared accounting fact contract (contract/v3.0.0-alpha.4 and later); an incremental fact deduped by fact_id.
